SeatId.description:
Identifier of a seat: one agent session (or human editing session) working in a repository.

Starts with `seat_`.

description:
One agent session (or human editing session) working in a repository.

There is exactly one seat per harness session. A seat is created on the first event of a
session.

branch.description: The checked-out branch. Absent when HEAD is detached.

harness.description: Name of the harness, for example `claude-code`.

last_seen_at.description: When the seat last produced an event (UTC).

pilot.description: The pilot (the human responsible for the seat), identified by git email address.

target_branch.description:
The branch this work will be integrated into. Claims only conflict within one target
branch.

worktree.description: Absolute path of the worktree the seat works in.

title: Seat
